mapper.select: select member_info.member_id AS memberId, member_info.name AS name, member_info.login_id AS loginId, member_info.email AS email, member_info.nickname AS nickname, member_info.member_type AS memberType, member_info.profile_img_url AS profileImgUrl, member_info.signup_type AS signupType, member_info.member_status AS memberStatus, member_info.member_role AS memberRole, member_info.email_verified AS emailVerified, member_info.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, member_info.deleted_at AS deletedAt from member_social_auth social_auth inner join member member_info on member_info.member_id = social_auth.member_id where social_auth.provider = #{provider} and social_auth.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId}

select member_id AS memberId, name, login_id AS loginId, email, nickname, member_type AS memberType, profile_img_url AS profileImgUrl, signup_type AS signupType, member_status AS memberStatus, member_role AS memberRole, email_verified AS emailVerified, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt from member where email = #{email} limit 1

select social_auth_id AS socialAuthId, provider, provider_user_id AS providerUserId, provider_email AS providerEmail, provider_email_verified_yn AS providerEmailVerifiedYn, provider_name AS providerName, provider_nickname AS providerNickname, provider_profile_image_url AS providerProfileImageUrl, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, member_id AS memberId from member_social_auth where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into member( name, login_id, email, nickname, member_type, phone, gender, birth, profile_img_url, signup_type, member_status, member_role, email_verified, email_verified_at, last_login_at ) values( #{name}, #{loginId}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{memberType}, #{phone}, #{gender}, #{birth}, #{profileImgUrl}, #{signupType}, #{memberStatus}, #{memberRole}, #{emailVerified}, #{emailVerifiedAt}, now() )
mapper.update: update member set last_login_at = now() where member_id = #{memberId} and member_status = 'ACTIVE' and deleted_at is null
update member set member_status = 'ACTIVE', deleted_at = null, last_login_at = now() where member_id = #{memberId} and member_status = 'WITHDRAWN' and deleted_at is not null
